subject: Supplier remittance preferences & PO onboarding
messages:
From: Amy Liu <amy@quanticsys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@quanticsys.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: remittance schedule and PO details

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again — Quantic Systems is moving forward with the SOW for the data-connector work and we want to get vendor setup and payment terms sorted so there are no hold-ups once the PO is issued. A few items from our side: 

- Preferred payment terms: Net 45. Our AP team typically runs Net 45 for larger integration projects.
- We can offer a 1.5% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 10 days.
- We'd like to request a 30% deposit at kickoff, with the remainder on the agreed payment term.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and a W-9. Can you confirm Redwood's approval path for Net 45 and whether the deposit is acceptable on the PO? Also let me know who should receive invoices / remit-to details and any PO formatting requirements.

Attachements: [vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)], [W9_QuanticSystems.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Amy Liu
Finance Ops | Quantic Systems
amy@quanticsys.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy@quanticsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: remittance schedule and PO details

Hi Amy —

On 2026-11-21 09:14 AM Amy Liu <amy@quanticsys.com> wrote:
> Thanks again — Quantic Systems is moving forward with the SOW for the data-connector work...

Appreciate the details and the attachments. Quick answers up front: our default is Net 30, but for strategic integrations we can approve Net 45 on a case-by-case basis once procurement and finance have the completed onboarding docs + signed SOW and PO. A 30% kickoff deposit is generally acceptable; we'll include that as an invoice line on the PO.

Next steps from our side: Marissa (procurement) will send the PO template and vendor-portal link to complete onboarding. Ben (finance) will confirm whether we can approve Net 45 for this engagement or if we require additional approvals. Can you confirm the EIN on the W-9 and provide an ACH remittance contact?

I'll leave the details to Marissa & Ben, copying them in.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy@quanticsys.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: remittance schedule and PO details

Hi Amy — thanks for sending the form. I attached our PO template to speed things up.

Summary of what we need to complete onboarding and evaluate Net 45 / deposit request:
- Completed vendor portal registration (link below) and vendor profile (legal name, EIN, DBA)
- Signed SOW + PO (we can draft the PO once we have the SOW and onboarding profile)
- ACH remit details (bank name, account number (encrypted field in portal), routing number)
- Invoice remit-to email: invoices@redwood.com — please copy ap@redwood.com on the first three invoices
- For Net 45 to be approved without exec signoff we need either: (a) total first-year spend < $100k, or (b) references + clean credit history from AP. Otherwise finance will route for SRM approval.
- For a 30% deposit: include a kickoff invoice flagged as "Deposit - PO line 1" and we will pay per the PO terms.

Attachments: [Redwood_PO_template.xlsx]
Vendor portal: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/onboard/abcd-1234

If you complete the portal and return the SOW we can generate the PO within 2 business days. Ben — can you confirm the finance side (Net 45 threshold, early-pay options)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Amy Liu <amy@quanticsys.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: remittance schedule and PO details

Marissa / Amy —

Thanks. Finance is willing to approve a conditional Net 45 for Quantic under these conditions: 
1) Signed SOW + PO in our system before the first invoice is submitted.
2) Vendor completes the portal with ACH remit details and W-9 on file.
3) Invoices include PO number, invoice number, and remit-to details.
4) For first engagement: spend cap for Net 45 approval is $250k total; above that we will need a CS/Finance review.

We can also offer an early-pay program (FastSet) that accelerates payment to Net 7 for a fee (3% of invoice). If Quantic prefers the deposit approach, Redwood will accept a 30% kickoff invoice and process it upon PO activation. 

Please send invoices to invoices@redwood.com and copy ap@redwood.com. Once the portal is completed I'll sign off on the Net 45 exception.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Director | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Amy Liu <amy@quanticsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@quanticsys.com
Date: 2026-11-24T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: remittance schedule and PO details

Hi team —

Thanks for the quick responses and clarity. We will: 
- Complete the Redwood vendor portal today (Dana in AP will upload the bank details and the signed W-9).
- Return the signed SOW so you can issue the PO. Please issue the PO with a 30% kickoff line item; we will submit a kickoff invoice upon PO activation.
- We accept the conditional Net 45 and understand the $250k threshold and the FastSet early-pay option.

AP contact for remittance/ACH: Dana Park (accounts-payable@quanticsys.com). If you can create the PO and confirm the PO number, I will include it on all invoices.

Attachments: [vendor_onboarding_completed.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Amy Liu
Finance Ops | Quantic Systems
amy@quanticsys.com
